name: Popover
summary: Anchor a floating card of rich content — a title, a body, and an optional arrow — to a trigger.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-popover> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Richer than a Tooltip: it carries a bold `title` over a body (slotted, or via the `content` attr) and holds interactive content. Twelve `placement`s — the 4 cardinal (top · bottom · left · right) plus the 8 edge-aligned (…-start / …-end, aligned to the trigger's start/end edge) — three `trigger`s (click · hover · focus) and a toggleable `arrow`. Interaction toggles the `open` attribute on a persistent panel (never rebuilt), so opacity and lift animate. With the opt-in `flip` the open panel is positioned from measured rects: it flips to the roomier side when the requested side does not fit, stays inside the viewport edges, and renders in the browser top layer, so no clipping ancestor or neighbouring layer can crop or cover it. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: top · bottom · left · right (8px offset), PLUS 8 edge-aligned (top-start/-end, bottom-start/-end, left-start/-end, right-start/-end) — same side, aligned to the trigger edge with the arrow offset near it

spec.label: Arrow
spec.value: optional 8px pointer at the panel edge, matches the surface + border

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: fade + 4px directional lift on open (ease-out, persistent node); closed, the panel is display:none and adds no layout or scrollable overflow

props.name: open
props.desc: Controlled open state; reflected attribute. open="false" counts as closed. React 19 assigns the property, so `open={isOpen}` works as written. React 18 writes a string attribute: `open={true}` becomes open="true" and `open={false}` becomes open="false", which is read as closed; the recommended pattern is `open={isOpen ? '' : undefined}`, which omits the attribute when closed.

props.name: placement
props.type: top | bottom | left | right | top-start | top-end | bottom-start | bottom-end | left-start | left-end | right-start | right-end
props.desc: Side the panel anchors to. The 4 cardinal values align the panel to the trigger's leading edge; the 8 edge-aligned values (…-start / …-end) pin it to the trigger's start/end edge with the arrow offset near that edge (AntD naming)

props.name: trigger
props.desc: How the panel opens. Click closes on outside-click + Escape (focus returns); hover/focus track pointer/focus

props.name: title
props.desc: Bold header rendered above the body (hidden when empty); also names the dialog panel when there is no aria-label

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the dialog panel, forwarded inside the shadow root; wins over title. A dialog popover needs one of the two: an unnamed dialog logs one console warning the first time it opens. Not used when the body is only a menu (the menu carries its own aria-label)

props.name: content
props.desc: Text body alternative to slotted content (used when nothing is slotted)

props.name: arrow
props.desc: Show the pointer arrow at the panel edge

props.name: flip
props.desc: Opt-in collision handling: while open the panel is placed with position:fixed from measured rects. It opens on the roomier side when its own side lacks room (reported on the host as `flipped` and `data-flipped`=side, arrow included), is clamped 8px inside the viewport, re-measures on resize, scroll and panel resize. Where the browser has the Popover API the open panel is shown in the top layer (popover="manual"), so no overflow, transform, filter, contain:paint or z-index ancestor can clip or cover it; without the API only an overflow:hidden/auto ancestor is escaped

props.name: [slot=trigger]
props.desc: The element that toggles the panel

props.name: [default slot]
props.desc: The body. The panel is role="dialog" named by aria-label or title; when the body is a single <aha-menu> or role="menu" element the panel takes no role and its trigger wrapper reads aria-haspopup="menu", so screen readers announce the menu (name it with aria-label on the menu) instead of an unnamed dialog around it

whenToUse.when: a small panel of rich or interactive content anchored to a control
a short, non-interactive hint on hover
a focused task that should block the rest of the page
a menu of actions from a button: it builds the trigger, panel and menu in one element

opinion.note: Trigger on click for interactive content (Tooltip owns hover). Give it a short `title` and a one-line body; a long form belongs in a Modal. A popover with no visible title still needs an `aria-label` (it is a dialog). A popover that only hosts an <aha-menu> is not a dialog: it drops the role, and the menu's own aria-label names it. A click trigger closes on outside-click and Escape (focus returns to the trigger) — both built in. A trigger click bubbles: clicking one popover's trigger closes any other open click popover, and a host can listen to that click.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — from the DS V3 Popover component-set ('the floating card popped by clicking or hovering'), matching the antd Popover matrix: a `title` header over a body (unlike the Tooltip's plain hint), the FULL 12-placement set — the 4 cardinal sides (top · bottom · left · right) PLUS the 8 edge-aligned ones (top-start, top-end, bottom-start, bottom-end, left-start, left-end, right-start, right-end — same side, aligned to the trigger's start/end edge with the arrow offset near that edge, AntD naming) — `trigger` (click · hover · focus) and a toggleable `arrow`. White elevated surface, standard 8 radius, soft ink shadow; title SemiBold text-default over a text-secondary body. Fade + 4px directional lift via the shared motion tokens on a persistent panel — no subtree rebuild on open/close.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: trigger click/hover/focus; fade + lift on open
click: outside-click + Esc close, focus returns; open/close composed

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is open (title + arrow set) so the panel is laid out.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-popover[data-probe]');var r=el.shadowRoot;var p=r.querySelector('.pop');var s=getComputedStyle(p);var t=r.querySelector('.title');var ts=getComputedStyle(t);var ar=r.querySelector('.arrow');var as=getComputedStyle(ar);return{bg:s.backgroundColor,radius:s.borderTopLeftRadius,border:s.borderTopColor,color:s.color,titleWeight:ts.fontWeight,titleText:t.textContent.length>0,arrowShown:as.display};})()
